alert_text: Critical credential-access compromise on vm-honeypot-win from external source IP <REAL_BAD_IP>. After 487 failed Windows logons (brute force / password guessing) against the Administrator account, a single authentication SUCCEEDED — confirming a successful brute-force compromise, not merely failed attempts. Post-compromise, the same session performed OS credential dumping from LSASS memory and then established an outbound HTTPS command-and-control channel to <REAL_BAD_IP> over web protocols, with data exfiltration over that C2 channel. Hands-on-keyboard active compromise; immediate containment of vm-honeypot-win is warranted. [SYNTHETIC PATH-VALIDATION]
